script_text: This week, Taurus, an Earth‑grounded Venus‑Saturn trine turns hidden wishes into real gains. Monday, Venus sextiles Saturn in your 2nd and 6th houses, stabilizing money for budgeting or raise. Tuesday, Mercury conjunct Neptune in your 9th house brings insight but talk; delay contracts till Wednesday. Thursday, Uranus in your 8th house squares the Sun in Aries, shaking finances and urging debt release. Friday‑Sunday, Venus enters your 3rd house, sextile Jupiter in your 11th, boosting charm and attracting friends — great for networking or a date. The weekend Moon in your 5th house opposes Pluto in your 11th, heating passion; use it for creative work, not power struggles. Best day: Wednesday, Mars trine Moon in your 10th house fuels career drive. Worst day: Thursday, Uranus square Sun spikes sudden money tension. Tip: Track shared expenses in a simple ledger and check it Thursday night. Follow for daily updates.
